import bpy,math
import numpy as np
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
wanted={o.name:o for cn in ['Coast_CraftWarehouse','Pier_Working'] for o in bpy.data.collections[cn].objects if o.type=='MESH' and o.get('natural_surface_wear')}
backup=ns['root']/'captures/surface_before_20261109_213235/harbor_coast_mcp.blend'
names=list(wanted)
with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(backup),link=False) as (src,dst):
    assert all(n in src.objects for n in names)
    dst.objects=names
# Copy every mesh before unlinking any imported object.
loaded=list(dst.objects)
copies=[(name,obj.data.copy()) for name,obj in zip(names,loaded)]
for name,mesh in copies:
    obj=wanted[name];mats=list(obj.data.materials);obj.data=mesh
    mesh.materials.clear()
    for m in mats:mesh.materials.append(m)
    co=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in mesh.vertices]);lo=co.min(0);hi=co.max(0)
    axis=1 if name.startswith('Walkboard_') else 0;cross=1-axis
    length=max(.001,hi[axis]-lo[axis]);width=max(.001,hi[cross]-lo[cross])
    seed=sum(ord(ch) for ch in name)
    for v in mesh.vertices:
        t=(v.co[axis]-lo[axis])/length;s=(v.co[cross]-lo[cross])/width
        fade=math.sin(math.pi*max(0,min(1,t)))
        v.co.z+=.0017*((2*s-1)**2-.5)*fade
        if seed%4==0 and t>.94 and s>.76:v.co[axis]-=.006*((t-.94)/.06)*((s-.76)/.24)
    obj['natural_surface_wear']='original vertices only';mesh.update()
# These copies have never been linked into any scene.
for obj in loaded:
    if obj.users_collection:raise RuntimeError('Unexpected linked backup object')
for obj in loaded:bpy.data.objects.remove(obj,do_unlink=True)
# Update the actual image files and material-bound images, not temporary images.
for kind,scale,rs in [('boat',.56,.72),('pier',.78,.82)]:
    mat=bpy.data.materials['BoatWood_Lit' if kind=='boat' else 'PierWood_Lit']
    if mat.get('relief_file_balanced'):continue
    for suffix in ['normal','roughness']:
        path=ns['root']/'assets'/(kind+'_wood_'+suffix+'.png')
        arr=ns['image_array'](path)
        if suffix=='normal':
            n=arr[:,:,:3]*2-1;n[:,:,:2]*=scale;n/=np.linalg.norm(n,axis=2,keepdims=True);arr[:,:,:3]=n*.5+.5
        else:arr[:,:,:3]=.9+(arr[:,:,:3]-.9)*rs
        ns['png'](path,arr)
        for im in bpy.data.images:
            if ns['Path'](im.filepath).name==path.name:
                if im.packed_file:im.unpack(method='REMOVE')
                im.reload();im.pack()
    mat['relief_file_balanced']=True
print('ORIGINAL_TOPOLOGY_WITH_RESTRAINED_WEAR',len(wanted),'objects; material-bound relief saved')
